name: Daejeon
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local/state property or cadastral services were identified, but no point-specific public parcel polygon was verified. No full geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Daejeon Metropolitan City operates an official spatial-information portal with dedicated real-estate and cadastral-information search. The portal describes real-estate information as linked to cadastral maps and provides lot-related information.
technicalBlocker: The viewer’s published WFS route returned HTTP 404 to ordinary anonymous direct requests, including GetCapabilities and a bounded one-feature query. No WUP point-specific parcel result could be verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the portal’s internal O2Map WFS route is available only through viewer-side routing or a separate service host, and whether a parcel covers the WUP point. No citywide coverage test was made.
nextStep: If the official viewer route becomes available through ordinary anonymous access, query a small bounded extent and allowlist only a parcel identifier and geometry.

officialSources.observation: Official Daejeon Metropolitan City Spatial Information Portal; exposes dedicated real-estate and cadastral-information search.
Official service description: location/address search and parcel-related real-estate information connected to cadastral maps.
Official cadastral-information search viewer page and published scripts.
Official viewer JavaScript uses the LSMD_CONT_LDREG WFS feature type and filters by PNU for a one-feature cadastral parcel response.
Official viewer config defines relative WFS route `o2map/services/wfs`.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Fetched official cadastral-info viewer and its static JavaScript/config. The code requests WFS 1.1.0 GETFEATURE for layer LSMD_CONT_LDREG, with one feature and CQL PNU equality; its output is read as GeoJSON geometry. The configured public route https://gis.daejeon.go.kr/o2map/services/wfs returned HTTP 404 for both GetCapabilities and a one-feature bounded locator query. No PNU was used and no geometry was retained.
